title: Query execution and performance
brief: Follow rows through scans, joins, grouping and sorting. Use measured plans to locate bad cardinality estimates, repeated work, spills and data movement; test a repair against realistic parameters and workload.

neighbouring_ownership.indexes: Owns access-path design, not all query repair.
neighbouring_ownership.incidents: Owns separating execution work from admission and lock waits.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-plans: Owns native PostgreSQL counters and plan behaviour.

title: Inside CockroachDB
brief: Trace SQL data through ordered keys, ranges, local storage and replicated ownership. Explain splits, leases and replica agreement with enough detail to see why a hotspot can persist as a cluster grows.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-transactions: Owns native intents and commit/retry paths.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-performance: Owns SQL/KV/network work and hot-range diagnosis.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns health, identity and removal procedures.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Owns transferable replica-agreement concepts; this article develops their native range, Raft and lease application.

title: CockroachDB table locality and region survival
brief: Choose regional-by-table, regional-by-row or GLOBAL tables and survival goals from actual access and failure requirements. Verify placement and survival, and distinguish structural reasoning from measured regional latency.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns native health and planned node removal.

title: Operating and securing a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Verify secure runtime identity, least privilege and tenant isolation. Use native evidence to diagnose under-replication and range health, then remove a node without consuming the cluster’s survival budget.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-performance: Owns expensive query and hot-key repairs.
neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns general movement and membership safety.
